title: Sha-3
summary: A Keccak-based (NIST SHA-3) cryptographic hash function available in SORA Nexus for NIST-standardized hashing and external compatibility, while internal traces use Poseidon2.
definition: A Keccak-based (NIST SHA-3) cryptographic hash function available in SORA Nexus for NIST-standardized hashing and external compatibility, while internal traces use Poseidon2.
tagline: Provides NIST-standardized hashing for regulatory compliance and external interoperability.
